description:
Found by s507d checking the `--` row of docs/pcl-commands.md.  perl 5.40.3 vs pcl on main 50dbd195:
  printf 'print "dash file @ARGV\n";\n' > ./-file.pl
  perl -- -file.pl a  -> dash file a, exit 0
  pcl  -- -file.pl a  -> Unknown option: file.pl / Usage: pl2cl [options] <file.pl> ..., exit 255
PCLSwitches::parse_argv takes `-file.pl` as the program correctly; the path then reaches pl2cl's Getopt (on the script-cache miss and on the transpile path) as a bare word.  Fix: pass `--` before the path wherever pcl or the runtime spawns pl2cl, or `./`-prefix a relative path that starts with `-`.  Rare; the docs do not show the case.


=== DONE (s507c, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-05) ===
FIX: `--` before the program path wherever pl2cl is spawned for a PROGRAM: `pcl`'s transpile (the source-switch / -e path) and the runtime's p-transpile-file (the script-cache miss, and module transpiles, where it is harmless); pl2cl's command-line-server client treats everything after `--` as a non-flag, so the server path stays reachable.  pl2cl's GetOptions already honours `--`.
PROBES (scratch/s507c/m3c): `pcl -- -file.pl a` (dash file a -file.pl, rc 0 = perl), the same twice (cache hit), `pcl -n -- -file.pl a` (perl's "Can't open a"), plain scripts and -e unchanged.
GUARDS: Pl/t/pcl-switches-01.t +2 rows (the cache path FAILS on the base; the -l transpile path too).
subject: LOW (found by s507d, main 50dbd195): a program file whose name starts with `-` cannot be run: `pcl -- -file.pl a` prints pl2cl's "Unknown option: file.pl" and its usage, exit 255 (perl: runs it); the path reaches pl2cl's option parser unprotected
